en: Ganthaganthasampayuttaduka (The Pair of the Conjoined with the Bound and the Unbound)

Dependent on a state that is both not a tie (*nagantha*) and dissociated from ties (*naganthavippayutta*), there arises a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).

Dependent on a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties, there arises a state that is dissociated from ties but is not a tie, by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is both not a tie...

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the ties (*naganthavippayutta*), there arise states that are both dissociated from the ties and not a tie, as well as states that are both dissociated from the ties and a tie, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from the ties and not a tie... [and so forth].
And a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties arises by way of root condition, dependent on a state that is a tie.
Dependent on a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties, a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties, a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties [arises] by way of root condition.
Both the non-fettered and the fettered states arise with root-cause condition.

Dependent on both the non-fettered and the non-fettered-dissociated, as well as the non-fettered and the fettered state, there arises a state that is both non-fettered and non-fettered-dissociated with root-cause condition. Both the non-fettered...

Dependent on a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties, as well as a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties and is not a tie but is a tie, there arises a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties, as well as a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties and is not a tie but is a tie, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties, as well as a state that is both not a tie and dissociated from ties and is not a tie but is a tie, there arises a state that is neither a tie nor dissociated from ties... [and so forth].
And states that are both dissociated from the ties and are neither-ties-nor-not-ties arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are nine [instances] under root; ... pe ... there are nine under non-disappearance. (Full detail for all.)
